name: s12_damaged_delivery_support_escalation
use_case: Support case escalation and service error recovery
branch: Customer reports delivered package for order O12 was damaged in transit; agent verifies identity and creates support escalation ticket
tests: the agent verifies order ownership on order O12 and creates an escalated support case for transit damage
instruction:
You received order O12 yesterday, but the packaging and items arrived damaged during transit. You want the agent to verify your order and open a formal support ticket for a replacement review.

Your details:
- Name: Leo Fitz
- Email: leo.fitz@example.com
- Postal Code: 75001
- Order ID: O12
- Issue: Damaged in transit

persona.name: Leo Fitz
persona.initial_message: Hello support desk. I received my package for order O12 yesterday, but the box was severely crushed and the contents were damaged during transit. I need someone to review this right away.

arguments.subject: Damaged goods upon delivery for order O12
arguments.details: Customer received damaged package and goods for order O12; requesting expedited replacement or supervisor review.
